                    ### Question
                    A 25-year-old male visits his physician because of fertility issues with his wife. Physical exam reveals bilateral gynecomastia, elongated limbs, and shrunken testicles. Levels of plasma gonadotropins are elevated. Which of the following is also likely to be increased in this patient:?

                    ### Options
                    opa. Testosterone
opb. Inhibin
opc. Aromatase
opd. Ejaculatory sperm
ope. Sertoli cells

### Enhanced Information (For Contextual Support):
In a patient with primary testicular failure presenting with elevated plasma gonadotropins, decreased testosterone production is expected. This leads to increased levels of inhibin and potentially increased Sertoli cell activity. Testosterone levels are likely to be decreased, so it is not expected to be increased in this patient. Aromatase activity may increase due to the imbalance in testosterone production. Ejaculatory sperm production is likely to decrease in this scenario.
